THE GATE WAS RED WHILE THIS RECORD SAID IT WAS GREEN, AND THE CI COULD NOT SEE IT. CI lints `-p zroutery-core --all-features` without `--all-targets`, so the library is linted and the integration tests are not. The wider command in this record — the one this node owns — sees them, and it was failing. The eighteen warnings were all in test files: four test suites and one module inside the library, none of them touched by the work that found them. The fix is mechanical and the gate is green; the record now says what the command actually does, which is the whole point of a record that names a command.
